sources.document_title: JST SH CONNECTOR catalog (1.0 mm pitch wire-to-board, crimp style), eSH.pdf
sources.locator: page 1: title 'SH CONNECTOR', Specifications block; 'PC board layout and Assembly layout' side entry type figure; JST logo footer
sources.evidence_extract: Specifications: current rating 1.0 A AC/DC (AWG #28); voltage rating 50 V AC/DC; temperature range -25 C to +85 C (including temperature rise in applying electrical current); contact resistance initial 20 mOhm max, 40 mOhm max after environmental tests; insulation resistance 100 MOhm min; withstanding voltage 500 VAC for one minute; applicable wire AWG #32 to #28, insulation O.D. 0.4-0.8 mm. PC board layout notes: viewed from the connector mounting surface; dimensions are reference values; pattern pitch tolerance +/-0.05 non-accumulating within +/-0.1.

sources.document_title: JST SH CONNECTOR catalog (1.0 mm pitch wire-to-board, crimp style), eSH.pdf
sources.locator: page 3: 'Header' section, Side entry type figure, Model No. table row for 4 circuits, Material and Surface finish, Notes 1-5
sources.evidence_extract: Model No. table, 4 circuits: top entry BM04B-SRSS-TB, side entry SM04B-SRSS-TB, dimension A 3.0, B 6.0 mm, 3,000 per reel (side entry). Side entry figure marks 'No. 1 circuit' at one end, 1 mm pitch, 2.9 height, 4.25 and 0.7 depth. Material: base contact copper alloy, tin-plated; base housing PA (heat resistance), natural (ivory); reinforcement copper alloy, tin-plated. Note 1: 'This product displays (LF)(SN) on a label.' Note 2: embossed tape and reel. Note 4: compatible with SR series IDC style socket.
